title: 수도방위사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:20675:20080229:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 20675, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (21) Omitted.

(22) The Decree on the Capital Defense Command is partially amended as follows:

In Article 5 (2), "Chief of the Presidential Security Office" shall be replaced with "Chief of the Office of the President".

In the latter part of Article 7, "Minister of Home Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Public Administration and Security".

(23) through (30) Omitted.
